name: frontal-sdk
description: Docs and headline operations of the Frontal TypeScript SDK, for MCP servers and agent tooling.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/sdk
docs.summary: The one-package entry point to Frontal: AI inference, agents, workflows, pipelines, knowledge graph, ontology, blob storage and 15 more services behind a single typed client.

docs.title: Frontal SDK
docs.summary: How to write correct code against the Frontal TypeScript SDK: setup, service map, model choice, error taxonomy, testing, and the checklist to run before returning code.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/core
docs.summary: Shared runtime for all Frontal TypeScript SDKs — HTTP client, auth, retries, pagination, polling, and typed errors.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/ai
docs.summary: AI inference SDK — text generation, streaming, embeddings, structured output, speech, transcription, and image/video generation.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/agents
docs.summary: Define, deploy, and observe AI agents with LangChain, LangGraph, and Vercel AI SDK integration.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/workflows
docs.summary: Workflow orchestration SDK — triggers, steps, approvals, templates, and execution tracking.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/pipelines
docs.summary: Declarative data pipeline SDK — ingest, transform, enrich, validate, and orchestrate with substrate awareness.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/graph
docs.summary: Graph entities, relationships, query, traversal, time travel, and semantic search.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/ontology
docs.summary: Client for the Frontal Ontology platform (`/v1/ontology/*`). The API is composed of independent subdomain services, each exposed as a namespace: `engine`, `objects`, `relationships`, `schemas`, `versions`, `validation`, `transformations`, `reasoning`, `rollouts`, `rollups`, `extract`, and `events`. (The `graph` subdomain is served by `@frontal-labs/graph`.)

docs.title: @frontal-labs/blob
docs.summary: Object storage SDK — upload, download, streaming, metadata, signed URLs, and copy/move operations.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/datasets
docs.summary: Dataset catalog — list datasets, read artifacts, browse schemas and sources, and ingest data.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/data
docs.summary: Data platform sub-domains — aggregations, archival, enrichment, exports, normalization, quality, serving, streams, sync, transformations, federated query and schema registry — behind one client.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/lineage
docs.summary: Data lineage — traverse the lineage graph, inspect nodes and edges, and analyze the impact of a change before you make it.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/observability
docs.summary: Logs, metrics, traces, alerts and dashboards — query and ingest.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/audit
docs.summary: Append-only audit events — log who did what to which resource, and query the trail.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/governance
docs.summary: Policies, compliance, roles, permissions and access checks.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/auth
docs.summary: Authentication — sign up/in, MFA, account self-service, and an admin surface for user management.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/billing
docs.summary: Customers, plans, subscriptions, invoices, wallets, meters, prices and add-ons.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/events
docs.summary: Event bus — topics, subscriptions, schemas, publish/subscribe and replays.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/webhooks
docs.summary: Outbound webhooks — register endpoints, inspect and retry deliveries, rotate secrets, and read delivery stats.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/schedules
docs.summary: Cron schedules for workflows and pipelines — create, pause, resume, trigger, and validate cron expressions.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/workers
docs.summary: Deploy and invoke edge workers.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/sandbox
docs.summary: Isolated code execution with a judge — run snippets, self-test, or submit against test cases.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/connectors
docs.summary: Source connectors — discover connector definitions, install them per tenant, and replay or diagnose sync runs.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/integrations
docs.summary: Third-party integrations — install providers with scoped credentials, run and replay actions, test connections and simulate policy.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/react
docs.summary: React hooks for the Frontal SDK. Thin, transport-agnostic, no framework lock-in: `useChat` talks to any route that returns `toUIMessageStreamResponse(...)`; the other hooks take objects from `new Frontal(...)`.

docs.title: @frontal-labs/testing
docs.summary: Test utilities for every Frontal SDK: a fetch-level mock with route matching and request assertions, pre-wired test clients, response builders and fixtures. No network, no real API key.

docs.title: Testing Guide
docs.summary: This guide covers testing strategies, tools, and best practices for the Frontal SDK monorepo.
